title: Homestead Act
summary: The Homestead Act, approved on 20 May 1862, let eligible adults claim 160 acres of surveyed public land. Claimants had to live on and farm the land for five years. President Abraham Lincoln signed the law after the southern states had seceded, and it set out the conditions under which settlers could receive public land.
